REGISTRATION OF FEATURE FILM DIRECTORS RULES, 2006
REGISTRATION OF
FEATURE FILM DIRECTORS RULES, 2006
[26th July, 2006]
S.R.O. 763(1)/2006, dated
20.7.2006.--In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 19 of the Motion
Pictures Ordinance, 1979 (XLIII of 1979), the Federal Government is pleased to
make the following rules, namely:‑
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) These rules shall be called the Registration of Feature
Film Rules, 2006.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.--(1) In
this rules, unless there is any thing repugnant in the subject or context:‑
(a) "applicant"
means a person who applies for his registration as a feature film director;
(b) "chairman"
in relation to a board, means the Chairman of the Central Board of Film
Censors;
(c) "Code"
means censorship of film code providing guidelines for censorship of films;
(d) "committee"
means a Committee constituted to interview applications under rule 5;
(e) "conditions"
means the conditions specified for the eligibility of an applicant;
(f) "feature
film" means cinematographic film meant for public exhibition in the cinema
houses; and
(g) "form"
means a form specified in Annexure to these rules.
(2) The words and expression used
but not herein defined shall have the same meanings as are respectively
assigned to them in the Motion Picture Ordinance, 1979 (XLIII of 1979)-
3. Application for
registration of feature film director.--(1) Any person who wishes to direct
a feature film shall, unless specifically exempted, apply for his registration
to the Federal Government on an application form at Annexure I in quadruplicate
with the National Tax Number and a treasury/state bank receipts for having
deposited Rs. 5,000 (Rupees five thousand only) in Account No. "1300 Misc.
Receipt, 1390-Others Fees for registration of Feature Film Directors".
(2) The amount shall not be
refundable, irrespective of the decision on the application. The general
criteria, inter alia, for registration shall be such as set out in Annexure II.
4. Examination of the
application.--(1) An application submitted under sub-rule (1) of rule 5
shall be examined and scrutinized by the CBFC at Islamabad in order to
ascertain whether the requirements for regist ation under these rules have been
fulfilled.
(2) It it appears to the CBFC
that the requirements for registration under these rules are not met, it shall
inform the application and ask him to fulfil such requirements within a period
of fifteen days.
(3) If the applicant fails to
fulfil the requirements within specified period, the CBFC shall recommend
rejection of the application to the Federal Government and registration fee so
deposited shall be forfeited.
5. Interview of the applicant.--(1)
In case the requirements of registration under these rules are met, the
Committee comprising Joint Secretary (Culture) and Chairman, CBFC shall interview
the applicant and forward its recommendations to the Federal Government for
approval of his registration.
(2) Those whose names are
register shall be informed on the address given in the application form. The
name of a registered fill Director shall be notified by the Federal Government
to the Chairman of the CBFC.
(3) The CBFC shall deal with
application for censorship of feature films if directed by a registered feather
film Director.
(4) Each registration shall be
valid for a period of four years from the date it is effected and shall be
renewable for another period of two years on payment of renewal fee of two thousand
rupees only:
Provided that
applicant applies for renewal of his registration at least fifteen days before
expiry of his last registration.
(5) Registration shall be renewed
only if the record of feature film director showed that he has directed at
least one feature film and has not violated the provisions of Film Censorship
Code while making a feature film during the period that he was registered.
